notes: Total 60 as published (header counts agree). 'OBJ' and 'Now for the Meat of the deck.' are headers, not cards.

Posted objective 'Hunt The Muthafookin Jedi Down/Wipe Your Ass With Their Sissy Capes' is a joke name, dested Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (posted text kept verbatim).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': the objective, Executor: Holotheatre, Visage Of The Emperor, Executor: Meditation Chamber, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, You Cannot Hide Forever; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Posted 'Shocking Information' is a Light card; dested the Dark counterpart Shocking Revelation (same text, cancels a hand scan such as Oola's, which the post gives as the reason).

Visage Of The Emperor, Janus Greejatus and Broken Concentration are the original Decipher cards (not the virtual (V) versions); Imperial Arrest Order is the Death Star II Effect (the Reflections II combo card did not exist yet).
Posted 'Grand Moff T' dested Grand Moff Tarkin; 'Zucky in Mist Hunter' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Dengar in Pun. One' Dengar In Punishing One; 'Mara Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand.
